items.title: A refined Noether normalization controlling the contraction of a given prime
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that for a prime in a polynomial ring over a field there is a finite map from another polynomial ring whose contraction of the prime is a coordinate subspace of the expected dimension (statement lines 28290-28297). The proof does not quote Noether normalization: it inducts on the number of variables, first applying a change of coordinates that makes a chosen element of the prime monic in one variable, then uses the induction hypothesis in one fewer variable and composes (proof lines 28299-28340). The coordinate change that produces finiteness is the step that carries the induction. H2.
